_readme: Persistent cross-session tracker for the cloud daily-digest routine. The cloud sandbox has no durable DB (see jobcopilot/cloud_fetch.py), so this git-tracked file is the memory: each run reads it, diffs freshly-fetched postings against 'key' to find genuinely new ones, updates 'last_seen_date' on ones still open, and records application status changes reported by the user. Not read by any pipeline code yet -- maintained by the Claude Code cloud routine session directly.
